findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_web" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the local/open web index and return a small reranked candidate set." → after: "Search SSearch. Set wait_for_coverage to search owned documents and, only if needed, external discovery on a miss."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
